records.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original square fantasy MMORPG achievement crest for reaching level 2, First Steps. A single huge, unmistakable light ivory boot-sole footprint viewed straight on, with simple separated toe and heel pads, dominates a dark warm near-black circular field. Enclose it in a simple warm brass medal. Hand-painted fantasy art, strong value contrast, bold silhouette, legible at 32 pixels even in grayscale. Minimal detail, no other objects, no words, letters, numbers, symbols, logos, watermarks, or imitation of any existing game or artist. No reference images.
